title: Special Executive Programme In Managing Healthcare Organization
description: Develop the essential leadership skills and strategies required to manage healthcare organizations effectively.
longDescription: This Special Executive Programme focuses on the core aspects of leadership, motivation, performance management, and teamwork in the healthcare sector. Participants will explore leadership theories, reward systems, and communication techniques to optimize healthcare management practices.
courseDetails: Understand the different aspects of motivation. Learn the importance of employee motivation in health and social care practices. Understand the motivation process. Learn the theories of motivation. Understand the relationship between motivation and reward. Learn the difference between power and influence. Understand the leadership power bases. Understand the concept of delegation in leadership. Learn the different aspects of emotional intelligence. Understand the concept of employee involvement. Learn the role of organisational culture in an organisation. The Concept of Employee Performance. Performance Monitoring and Evaluation. The Concept of Performance Management. The Concept of Goal Theory and SMART Goals. Key Performance Challenges Faced in Healthcare Industry. Key Performance Indicators in Health And Social Care. Probation Period. Types of Performance Reviews Systems. Performance Appraisal. Benchmarking. Codes of Practice. Disciplinary Issues. The Concept of Diversity. Concept Of Employee Rewards And Reward System. Objectives And Types Of Reward. Types Of Reward Systems. Types Of Healthcare Reward Systems. Four Pillars Of Workplace Fulfilment. Concept Of Job Evaluation. Methods And Process Of Job Evaluation. Concept Of Employee Remuneration. Factors Influencing Employee Remuneration. Factors Influencing Healthcare Employee Remuneration. Components Of Pay. Identifying the Development Needs Of The Healthcare Employees Understand the concept of employee training and development. What are learning models? Types of learning models and styles. Employee learning process. Group development and its process. The concept of employee empowerment. The concept of job orientation and job design. The Concept and Types of Healthcare Teamwork. Difference between Team and Group. Various models of Teamwork. The Concept of Team Building and its Essentials. The Concept and Reasons for Workplace Politics. The Concept of Anti-discriminatory Practice. Leadership and their Application to Healthcare. The concept of organisational communication. The concept of delegation in health and social care. The concept of supervision in health and social care. Participants will examine leadership concepts specific to the health and social care environment, including leadership competencies, styles, and challenges. The programme also delves into the role of motivation, emotional intelligence, and reward management in improving employee performance. Critical topics such as performance evaluation, team management, and employee development in healthcare will be covered. Practical insights into communication, delegation, and organizational culture will prepare participants to lead effectively in healthcare settings. After the successful completion of this course, you will understand the following: Leadership Concepts in Health and Social Care: The Role of Motivation in Health and Social Care: Performance Monitoring and Evaluation: Reward Management in Health and Social Care: Learning and Job Designing in Health and Social Care: Managing Teams In Health And Social Care: Communication and Delegation in Health and Social Care:

Participants will examine leadership concepts specific to the health and social care environment, including leadership competencies, styles, and challenges. The programme also delves into the role of motivation, emotional intelligence, and reward management in improving employee performance. Critical topics such as performance evaluation, team management, and employee development in healthcare will be covered. Practical insights into communication, delegation, and organizational culture will prepare participants to lead effectively in healthcare settings.
